items.text: Cube-shaped voxel planet (128³ world, 68-block faces)
Walk off any edge - gravity rotates onto the next face
Six biome faces: Meadow, Forest, Desert, Tundra, Highlands, Ashlands
Caves, lava layer, ore depth bands, glowing Starcore core chamber
Trees, cacti, flowers, lakes, frozen lakes, lava lakes
Flowing water and lava
Hold-to-mine with tool tiers (hand → wood → stone → iron → diamond)
Building with 50+ blocks, torches, lamps, glass, wool colours
Crafting list, crafting table and furnace stations, furnace fuel
16-step mission guide from first tree to escape
Health, fall/lava/cactus damage, food, regeneration
Ladders, doors, beds and chests
Pigs, cows and sheep (coloured wool)
Zombies (burn in daylight) and exploding Boomers
Swords, critical hits, knockback, TNT with chain reactions
Final boss: the Core Sentinel (magma bolts, slam shockwave, enrage, minions)
More cave creatures
Rocket parts: hull, engine, fuel cells, navigation core
Launch pad placement and launch sequence
Launch cinematic and ending screen with stats
Procedural pixel-art textures and item icons (no external assets)
Day/night that sweeps across every face, moonlight, stars, sunsets
Real-time sun shadows, torch lights, glow, ambient occlusion, fog, clouds
Synthesized sound effects and ambient music
First person, third person (V) and planet map view (hold M)
Settings menu (FOV, render scale, volume)
Play-in-browser web build
Godot 4.7 Forward+, chunked meshing (16³), world builds in ~1.3 s
Autosave + Continue, Survival and Creative (flying) modes
Retina-aware render scale (~60 FPS on a MacBook at 5K window)
Headless simulation + end-to-end flow tests

log.title: First playable build
notes: Built the full game loop: spawn → trees → tools → ores → core → rocket → boss → escape.
Verified edge-walking gravity, mining, crafting, boss fight, launch, ending and save/continue in headless tests.
Tuned rendering for Retina screens: half-res 3D with full-res UI, MSAA/FSR removed (27 → ~60 FPS).
Fixed missing pickaxe heads in item icons and flickering ground detection at high frame rates.
